items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: So Zach Whyte heard that we... He had a big band in Cincinnati, and he heard that we was down there in this town, playing there.

ctx.x: played about three nights. So Zach Whyte heard that we... He had a big band in Cincinnati, and he heard that we was down there in this town, playing there. And he needed nine men in his band. I think his band had broke up or something, and he wanted nine of us. We were going to go with it, but he didn't want the whole band; he just wanted nine of us.
Who did he want to leave behind?
